adaptive.title: Adaptive TDEE
adaptive.building: Building up data: {available} / {required} days with both weight + diary
adaptive.until_ready: Until ready, your fixed goal of {value} {unit} applies.
adaptive.help_intro: Adaptive TDEE learns your true daily energy expenditure from your weight trend over the last 35 days, paired with how much you actually ate. The math:
adaptive.help_step_1: Smooth your weight series (linear regression over 35 days).
adaptive.help_step_2: Convert the trend into daily energy balance (1 kg of body mass ≈ 7,700 kcal).
adaptive.help_step_3: TDEE = average daily intake − that daily balance.
adaptive.help_best_weigh: Weigh yourself frequently — daily is best, every other day is fine. Sparse weights are interpolated, but more measurements = tighter signal. A connected scale (Withings, Fitbit, Garmin, Health Connect) is automatic; manual body-stats entries also work.
adaptive.help_best_log: Log your food consistently. Missing days are dropped from the calculation. The estimate gets noisy if you log half your days.
adaptive.help_best_switch: Don't switch goals mid-window. The 35-day rolling average converges over time. If you bounce between cuts and bulks weekly, the learned TDEE will lag.
adaptive.help_best_reweigh: Re-weigh in similar conditions — first thing in the morning, after using the bathroom, before food/drink. Day-to-day fluctuations are mostly water; the trend is what matters.
adaptive.help_caveats: Caveats. Big changes in activity (started running, broke a leg) take ~2 weeks to fully reflect. Travel weeks with under-logged food can pull the estimate up. The learned TDEE is multiplied by your goal factor (Lose -20% / Maintain / Gain +20%) to get your actual daily target.

actions.bulk_import_desc: Paste JSON or upload a CSV to add multiple foods at once. Useful for foods that aren't on Open Food Facts. A template is provided so an LLM can extract label data into the right shape.
actions.import_json_desc: Restores from a previously exported JSON file. Merges with existing data, does not erase what's already here.
actions.export_json_desc: Lighter portable format, JSON only, no images. Useful for sharing data between accounts or quick text-based exports.
actions.export_diary_csv_desc: Downloads your full diary history as a spreadsheet. Useful for analysis in Excel or Google Sheets.
actions.export_activity_csv_desc: Downloads your full manual activity log (name, calories, duration, distance, MET) as a spreadsheet.

toast.connected: Trace AI connected, assistant is ready

settings_trace.env_lock_banner: Configured via environment variables, changes are disabled.

labels.enable_desc: Adds a floating chat button to all pages
labels.base_url_desc: Any OpenAI Compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint, Ollama, LM Studio, LocalAI, vLLM, llama.cpp's server, DeepSeek, Groq, Together AI, Mistral La Plateforme, etc. Don't include the path, just the origin.
labels.custom_model_hint: Enter the exact model ID from the vendor. Use this if the preset dropdown doesn't have the model you want.
labels.reliability_title: Tool calls reliability varies by model.
labels.reliability_body: Llama 3.1+, Mistral, Qwen 2.5+ handle them well. Smaller or older models may break Smart Log + Goal Insights silently. Vision (image attachments) needs a multimodal model. If you're unsure, start with a known-good model and check the chat works before relying on it.
labels.api_key_ph_local: Leave blank for local endpoints (Ollama, etc.)
labels.key_stored_device: Your key is stored on this device.
labels.key_stored_server: Your key is stored securely on the server.
labels.key_hint_oai_compat: Local endpoints (Ollama, LM Studio, etc.) typically don't need a key. Cloud providers like DeepSeek or Groq do, get one from their dashboard.
labels.smart_log_desc: Hold the assistant button, speak what you ate, AI parses the items and meal slot, matches your food database, then confirms before saving
labels.voice_lang_desc: Language the microphone listens for. Defaults to your device language, override if you speak a different language than your device is set to.
labels.trigger_yesterday: "same as yesterday for lunch" → copy yesterday's items
labels.smart_log_readme: See the Smart Log section in the README for full examples and privacy details.
labels.activity_estimate_desc: When you log a workout via Trace without a calorie number ("I hiked 10 miles"), let Trace estimate the burn from your body profile. Estimations need your weight, height, age, and sex on file, missing any pauses the estimator and Trace will ask for a number instead.
labels.goal_insights_desc: The assistant analyzes your intake trends and proactively suggests goal adjustments when patterns are consistent

toast.restored_summary: Restored {foods} foods · {meals} meals · {recipes} recipes · {diary} days · {wellness} metrics
toast.upload_too_large: Upload failed: file exceeds the maximum size allowed by your server or reverse proxy. If accessing remotely, try uploading from your local network.

confirm.restore_local: Restore "{name}"? Existing data is merged, not erased.

full_backup.desc_server: A complete snapshot of everything: all user data, diary, foods, meals, recipes, settings, and uploaded images. Saved on the server and available to download or restore at any time.
full_backup.desc_local: A complete snapshot of everything: all foods, meals, recipes, diary, wellness data, workouts, settings, AND embedded image files. Saved to your device's Documents folder, ready for phone-to-phone transfer without needing a server.
full_backup.env_lock_title: Locked by BACKUP_SCHEDULE / BACKUP_TIME / BACKUP_RETENTION env var
full_backup.retention_note: Keeps the {n} newest backup; older archives prune automatically after each run.
full_backup.retention_note_plural: Keeps the {n} newest backups; older archives prune automatically after each run.
full_backup.retention_note_local: Keeps the {n} newest auto-backup; manual exports are never pruned.
full_backup.retention_note_local_plural: Keeps the {n} newest auto-backups; manual exports are never pruned.
full_backup.empty_server: No backups yet — click Create Backup to get started.
full_backup.empty_local: No backups yet — tap Create Backup to get started.

danger.clear_data_desc: Permanently deletes all diary entries, foods, meals, and body stats. Settings and credentials are kept.
danger.clear_settings_desc: Resets all preferences, credentials, and API keys to defaults. Food and diary data are kept.

dialogs.clear_data_msg: This will permanently delete all diary entries, foods, meals, and body stats. Settings and credentials are kept. This cannot be undone.
dialogs.clear_settings_msg: This will reset all preferences, credentials, and API keys to defaults. Food and diary data are kept. This cannot be undone.
dialogs.restore_msg: This will replace all current data with the contents of this backup. This cannot be undone.
dialogs.upload_restore_msg: This will replace all current data with the contents of the uploaded backup. This cannot be undone.
dialogs.delete_backup_msg: This backup file will be permanently removed from the server.

push.test_failed_hint: {provider} test failed, check the URL and credentials below
push.device_desc: Alerts delivered directly to this device, native on Android and browser pop-ups on desktop/PWA
push.push_service_desc: Server-relayed alerts via Apprise, Gotify, or ntfy — useful for PWA users or Home Assistant

reminders.water_desc: Periodic reminders to stay hydrated (8am to 10pm)
reminders.meal_desc: Daily reminders to log your meals
reminders.weighin_desc: Morning reminder to step on the scale
reminders.bedtime_desc: Evening nudge to wind down for sleep
reminders.wind_down_desc: Extra nudge before bedtime to start winding down
reminders.smart_message_desc: Adjust the reminder based on last night's sleep (if tracked)

alerts.goals_desc: Celebrates when you hit any daily goal, calories, protein, carbs, fat, water, steps, sleep, and more
alerts.steps_desc: Midday nudge if you're behind on your step goal
alerts.wellness_desc: Warns when HRV drops significantly, sleep quality declines, or resting heart rate spikes
alerts.workouts_desc: Recap after a workout syncs, duration, distance, calories burned
alerts.weekly_desc: Weekly digest with average calories, protein, steps, sleep, goal hit rate, and weight change, delivered by push notification and email (if configured)
alerts.sync_failures_desc: Alert when Fitbit, Garmin, or Withings sync fails

empty.no_integrations_desc: Enable Fitbit or Withings in Settings → Wellness to start syncing health data.
empty.no_device_native_desc: Connect to your NutriTrace server in Settings → Server Connection and link a wellness device to see your data here.
empty.no_device_desc: Connect a wellness device in Settings → Wellness to start tracking your health data.

connect.fitbit_desc: Authorize NutriTrace to read your Fitbit data via Google Health. You'll be redirected to Google to approve access, then brought back here.

hint.tap_sync: Tap Sync to pull the latest data from your connected device.

empty.hint_food_metric: Log food in your diary to see trends here
empty.hint_wellness: Connect a fitness tracker in Settings → Wellness
empty.hint_other: No entries found — try a different date range
